race.comment: OAKFIELD VIRGINIA (6) has the most appealing blend of race fitness and recent substance. She was only beaten a length and a half in mid-week company at Warwick Farm after being blocked early, and her Scone second on soft ground the run prior reads well for a maiden of this standard. Winkers go on and looks the one to beat. DWIGHT (2) is the obvious danger, having placed at his past three and finished strongly when second to Sauvitude at Hawkesbury last start, though the ten-start maiden record keeps him just behind the top pick. Well drawn and can run a big race again. HALEKULANI (3) resumes. Spelled after he failed to run the 1600m out with a tiring last at Wyong last August. Ran fourth in a recent Beaumont (Newcastle) trial and is lightly raced enough to improve sharply. VINTAGE BELL (5) was sound on debut at Scone when beaten just over two lengths at generous odds, and while the quick back-up and first look at around 1250m are questions. This stable must always be respected.
